info.title: suno-api
info.description: Unofficial API for Suno.ai music generation. We update quickly, please star. Demo: https://suno.gcui.ai Docs: https://suno.gcui.ai/docs

tags.name: Suno API
tags.description: Endpoints for interacting with Suno music generation

tags.name: OpenAI Compatible
tags.description: Endpoints compatible with OpenAI API specifications

post.description:
The custom mode enables users to provide additional details about the music, such as music genre, lyrics, and more. 2 audio files will be generated for each request, consuming a total of 10 credits.
`wait_audio` can be set to API mode:
- By default, it is set to `false`, which indicates the background mode. It will only return audio task information, and you will need to call the `/api/get` endpoint to retrieve detailed audio information.
- If set to `true`, it simulates synchronous mode. The API will wait for a maximum of 100s until the audio is generated, and will directly return the audio link and other information. Recommended for use in GPTs and other agents.

prompt.description: Detailed prompt, including information such as music lyrics.
prompt.example:
[Verse 1]
Cruel flames of war engulf this land
Battlefields filled with death and dread
Innocent souls in darkness, they rest
My heart trembles in this silent test

[Chorus]
Silent battlegrounds, no birds' song
Shadows of war, where we don't belong

wait_audio.description: Whether to wait for music generation. Default is false (async). Set to true (sync) to wait up to 100s.

200.description: Successfully started generation or returned generated audio details.

post.description:
Generates audio based on a prompt, automatically filling in lyrics. 2 audio files will be generated for each request, consuming a total of 10 credits.
`wait_audio` can be set to API mode:
- By default, it is set to `false` (background mode). Returns audio task information; use `/api/get` to retrieve details.
- If set to `true` (synchronous mode). Waits up to 100s for audio generation and returns direct links. Recommended for GPTs.

prompt.example: A popular heavy metal song about war, sung by a deep-voiced male singer, slowly and melodiously.

wait_audio.description: Whether to wait for music generation. Default is false (async). Set to true (sync) to wait up to 100s.

200.description: Successfully started generation or returned generated audio details.

post.description: Generate lyrics based on a textual prompt.

prompt.example: A song about a lonely robot searching for meaning.

post.description: Extends the length of an existing audio clip. This typically creates a new clip based on the original and the extension point.

audio_id.description: The ID of the audio clip to extend.

extend_at.description: Timestamp in seconds from which to extend the audio. Found in the metadata of an audio clip.

post.description: Generates a whole song by concatenating a base audio clip with its extensions.

clip_id.description: The ID of the base audio clip to use for concatenation. This clip should have extensions.

200.description: Successfully started concatenation or returned concatenated audio details.

get.description: Retrieves information for one or more audio clips. If `ids` parameter is omitted, it will attempt to retrieve information for all available audio clips (behavior might be paginated or limited by the backend).

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Audio IDs, separated by commas. If omitted, all music will be returned (or a default list).

404.description: Not Found - One or more IDs not found.

get.description: Retrieves information for a specific audio clip by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the audio clip to retrieve.

400.description: Bad Request - ID is missing or invalid.

404.description: Not Found - Clip ID not found.

get.description: Retrieves information about the user's current quota and usage.

credits_left.description: Remaining credits. Each generated audio consumes credits (typically 5 per segment).

period.description: Period for which the quota applies (e.g., 'day').

post.description: Generates music using a prompt, in a format compatible with OpenAI's `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint. Expects a `messages` array and uses the 'user' role content as the prompt. Returns a markdown string with song title, cover image, lyrics, and audio URL.

messages.description: An array of message objects, similar to OpenAI's chat format. The content of the message with role 'user' will be used as the prompt.

model.description: Optional. Model to use (e.g., 'suno-v3'). Currently, the backend uses a default model.

200.description: Successfully generated music and returned details in markdown format.

schema.example:
## Song Title: Galactic Warriors
![Song Cover](https://cdn.suno.ai/image.png)
### Lyrics:
[Verse]
In cosmos vast, where stars ignite...
### Listen to the song: https://cdn.suno.ai/audio.mp3

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid message format or missing user message.

image_url.description: URL of the music cover image.

lyric.description: Lyrics of the music. May be null if instrumental or if lyrics were not generated.

audio_url.description: URL to download the audio file.

video_url.description: URL to download the music video (if available).

model_name.description: Name of the Suno model used (e.g., 'chirp-v3-5').

gpt_description_prompt.description: Prompt used if generated via simple mode (auto-lyrics).

prompt.description: The final prompt used for generation.

tags.description: Tags or genre of the music. Can be null.

duration.description: Duration of the audio in seconds. May be null if not yet processed.

error_message.description: Error message if generation failed. Null otherwise.

metadata.description: Additional metadata which can include extension points, etc.

extend_at.description: Timestamp in seconds indicating where the track can be extended from. Present if the track is part of a chain or can be extended.

AudioInfo.title: Audio Information
AudioInfo.description: Detailed information about a generated audio clip.
